description: This PHP class 'NotEqualsOperator' defines a comparison operator used in filtering operations within the SuiteCRM JSON API v1. It provides methods to return filter and SQL representations of the 'not equals' comparison, and validates the operator input.

classes.name: NotEqualsOperator
classes.description: A comparator operator class that represents the 'not equals' operation in filtering, providing filter and SQL specific representations and validation.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator string 'ne' for 'not equals'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string '!=' for 'not equals'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the provided operator string is valid for this comparator, throwing an exception if the input is not a string.
